item.title: Thriller at Killers Big Wave Event Gets Green Light for February 7
item.description: The Thriller at Killers Big Wave event on Todos Santos Island in northern Baja got the green light for February 7 from contest director Gary Linden.

item.title: Watch Josh Ku Make Extraordinary Crossing From Uluwatu to G-Land on a Foil
item.description: Josh Ku isn't a guy who shies from a challenge. He made history by completing a 58-mile crossing from Uluwatu on Bali to G-Land on Java on a SUP foil.

item.title: Snowboarder Mark McMorris Crashes in Training, Drops Out of Olympic Big Air Event
item.description: After a brutal crash, Canadian snowboarder Mark McMorris will be out for the Winter Olympic big air event, but says things are "looking up" for future events.

item.title: With John John Florence Saying No to the Tour, Here’s A Brief History of ‘Freesurfing’
item.description: John John Florence has left the CT, committed to freesurfing. So here's a brief history of the surfing professional that doesn't compete.

item.title: Utah’s Snowpack Hits Record Low Average
item.description: A report issued by the U.S. Department of Agriculture's National Resources Conservation Service has declared Utah's snowpack for this winter is at record lows.

item.title: Study Shows Deep-Sea Mining Could Harm Biodiversity as It Discovers New Species
item.description: A new study looked into the harm that mining operations could cause to biodiversity deep beneath the ocean. It also discovered new species in the process.

item.title: Parts of the Los Angeles Coastline Could Be Designated as a National Park
item.description: The National Park Service is asking for public input on a potential national park designation for parts of the Los Angeles coast.

item.title: Olympic Ski Jumpers Accused of Injecting Acid into Penises in Order to Jump Farther
item.description: Ski jumpers have been accused of augmenting their penises for competitive gain, prompting a response from Olympic anti-doping authorities.

item.title: ‘Shark Whisperer’ Ocean Ramsey Thinks This Shark Repellent Actually Works
item.description: Ocean Ramsey knows sharks. She spends a lot of time around them, and she thinks that this shark repelling gadget might actually work. But does it really?

item.title: King Tides and Big Barrels in Los Angeles This Week
item.description: The King Tides woke up the ocean in Los Angeles this week, and it delivered massive surf, heavy sets, and raw power that rolled straight into the beach.
